new_material_candidates.name: Test-Time Mixture of World Models
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Adapts routing over multiple learned world models at test time and supports zero-shot adaptation plus few-shot world-model expansion in embodied-agent environments.

new_material_candidates.name: STAD — Temporal Test-Time Adaptation with State-Space Models
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Provides a probabilistic state-space approach to gradual temporal test-time adaptation, with public executable support for STAD and FMoW-Time.

reference_or_screened.name: Test-Time Adaptation without Source Data for Out-of-Domain Bioactivity Prediction
reference_or_screened.reason: The method is peer-reviewed and potentially relevant to structured-data ML, but its verified contract is protein-ligand bioactivity under scaffold, protein, and assay shift; no official executable implementation was located during this bounded review.

reference_or_screened.name: TTVS
reference_or_screened.reason: Its published evaluation concerns self-evolving reasoning models over test queries rather than a materially tool-using multi-step agent environment.

reference_or_screened.name: Textual Model Predictive Control
reference_or_screened.reason: Its verified tasks are text-generation alignment tasks such as translation, long-form generation, and program synthesis rather than a matched tool-using agent system.

reference_or_screened.name: DeAR
reference_or_screened.reason: DeAR is a task-adaptation and generalization method using learned tokens and role-based attention control; the reviewed evidence does not establish the same unlabeled deployment-time adaptation contract as the A-H1 TTA candidates.

reference_or_screened.name: IMA and TMA
reference_or_screened.reason: Useful lightweight VLM-TTA evidence, but workshop-level evidence does not currently add a necessary claim-bearing role beyond the substantially populated peer-reviewed E3 comparator pool.

reference_or_screened.name: Test-Time Efficient Pretrained Model Portfolios for Time Series Forecasting
reference_or_screened.reason: Model-portfolio selection and ensembling are relevant structured-ML mechanisms, but the verified contract is time-series forecasting rather than a generally matched E2 investigation or adaptation experiment.

n_h2_reference_research.name: TMoW
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Adapts mixtures of learned world models across unseen embodied-agent domains.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: The method does not demonstrate one learned decision mechanism transferred into structured-ML and vision systems.

n_h2_reference_research.name: WebFactory
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Transfers learned web-agent behavior from generated offline environments toward online web settings.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: The transfer boundary remains within GUI/web-agent systems.

n_h2_reference_research.name: Relational Task Extrapolator
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Learns relations between tasks for extrapolation.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: No evidence verifies one common decision policy spanning E1, E2, and E3.

n_h2_reference_research.name: Learning-To-Measure
n_h2_reference_research.reason: Its demonstrated transfer remains within structured-data active feature acquisition.

stopping_rule.reason: The bounded refinement discovered TMoW and STAD, both materially distinct externally evidenced candidates absent from prior governed Task-8 candidate artifacts.
